issues.legal_issue: A master plan prepared after the commencement of the urban land ceiling law cannot defeat the agricultural-land exclusion or increase the excess vacant land determined under the law.
material_facts: The land was mainly used for agriculture and was entered in the revenue or land records as agricultural before the appointed day; these matters were undisputed.
No master plan existed for the area when the law commenced, but a master plan prepared later specified the land for a purpose other than agriculture.

The competent authority determined a larger area as excess vacant land than the District Judge did, and the High Court relied on the later master plan in rejecting the landholder’s challenge and partly allowing the State’s challenge.
issues.conclusion: The later master plan could not be used to deny the agricultural-land exclusion or increase the excess vacant land. The District Judge’s determination was restored.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 2(o) and Explanation (C) of the Urban Land (Ceiling and Regulation) Act, 1976, land specified for a non-agricultural purpose in a master plan is denied the agricultural-land treatment only if that master plan existed when the Act commenced. The reference to a master plan in Section 2(h) and the scheme of the Act, including Sections 3 and 5, support fixing the relevant rights and liabilities at commencement; later proceedings merely quantify them. Neither a landholder’s later actions nor the authorities’ later actions may alter the excess-land position fixed at commencement.

rule.if: urban_land_ceiling_proceeding and land_mainly_used_for_agriculture and land_recorded_as_agricultural_before_appointed_day and no_master_plan_at_commencement and later_master_plan_specifies_nonagricultural_use

predicates.urban_land_ceiling_proceeding: The matter is a proceeding to determine vacant land held in excess of a ceiling under an urban land ceiling scheme.
predicates.land_mainly_used_for_agriculture: The land was mainly used for agriculture.
predicates.land_recorded_as_agricultural_before_app: The land was entered in the relevant land records as agricultural before the legally relevant appointed day.
predicates.no_master_plan_at_commencement: No master plan for the area existed when the ceiling law commenced there.
predicates.later_master_plan_specifies_nonagricultu: A master plan prepared after commencement specified the land for a purpose other than agriculture.

issues.definition: When agricultural land was recorded as such before the appointed day, no master plan existed at commencement, and a later plan specifies a non-agricultural use, that later plan does not increase the excess vacant land determined in an urban land ceiling proceeding.
